title: EMT conduit, 3/4 in trade size, 10 ft stick

sources.citation: real-world: 3/4 trade size steel EMT, outside diameter 0.922 in = 23.42 mm, nominal wall 0.049 in = 1.24 mm; steel-EMT makers’ published dimension tables for ANSI C80.3 / UL 797 tubing (cited by number), read 2026-11-12. No NEC Chapter 9 table is used. The body box rounds the diameter up to 24 mm (even, so the ends sit on whole millimetres).

real-world: EMT is sold in 10 ft (3048 mm) lengths (makers’ packaging tables, read 2026-11-12); sizeMm is the uncut stick along +x and the body diameter (24 mm). Cut ends are taken as square and reamed (no burr modelled).
game-design: a new stick is cut to 1000 mm; raceway.cut makes pieces from 50 mm to the full stick.
